title: feat(types,components,app-shell,plugin-gantt): the last small P1 sites of objectui#8347 — action:bar into @object-ui/types, a runtime-only isAnimationActive, gantt reads typed (objectui#11355)
body:
Fixes #11355
Clause-②: yes (widening)

Round 2 of this card: the three P1 sites of objectui#8347's preparation that round 1 handed back, done as the seat ruled in comment 5944471936. Each package was measured under objectui#8347's P1 mutation (the `[key: string]: any` on `BaseSchema` in `packages/types/src/base.ts` removed, `@object-ui/types` rebuilt) before and after. Every mutation went through `ablation-replace`, and every restore was proved: blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty, dist rebuilt with the signature count back to 2.

**The Clause-② arm is a widening.** `@object-ui/types` gains one exported type (`ActionBarSchema`) and one TypeScript member (`ObjectChartSchema.isAnimationActive`). No zod face changes. No published accept set narrows: the old `ActionBarSchema`, the one that had the index signature, was never on `@object-ui/components`' entry, and that package's `exports` map has no subpath to it.

## Item 1: `action:bar` moves into `@object-ui/types` (ruling B)

- **The type.** `ActionBarSchema` is declared in `packages/types/src/ui-action.ts` and exported from the package entry. `actions` and `systemActions` are `UIActionSchema[]`, and `location` is the spec's `ActionLocation`, both by reference. The other members keep the types they had.
- **⛔ No index signature (H1 held).** Measured with the type checker, not grep:
  - `@object-ui/components` compiles, both programs at exit 0, with the old declaration's own signature removed. So the renderer reads no undeclared key.
  - Positive control: also dropping `gap` gives TS2339 at the renderer's `schema.gap` read.
  - An AST census of every object literal with `type: 'action:bar'` in tracked TS/TSX found 47 literals. None of them writes an undeclared key.
- **components (H2).** `action-bar.tsx` imports the type. The signature on the render function's parameter annotation (objectui#4422, pinned by `forwardref-props-annotation.guard.test.ts`) stays. No re-export is kept and nothing is added to the components entry. `action-bar.test.tsx` imports the type from `@object-ui/types`.
- **app-shell.**
  - `EnvironmentListToolbar` (x2), `InterfaceListPage` and `ObjectView` build their bar as a typed `ActionBarSchema` const and hand it to `SchemaRenderer`. `useOfferedNavRunAction.test.tsx` does the same.
  - Why a typed const and not `satisfies`: a throwaway probe showed that a `satisfies` literal stays fresh. It is excess-checked again against `BaseSchema` at the prop, so under P1 it is still TS2353.
- **Docs.** The types README lists `ActionBarSchema` under a new "Action Components" heading.

## Item 2: `ObjectChartSchema.isAnimationActive`, runtime-only (ruling A)

- **H3: the member rests on two `object-chart` producers.** Corrected after the at-tier record 5945376323; this bullet first said four hosts write the key through this type.
  - `DashboardRenderer` and `DashboardGridLayout` set it on the `object-chart` nodes they build, and `ObjectChart` spreads the node into the schema it hands `ChartRenderer`, which reads `schema.isAnimationActive`.
  - `DatasetWidget` and `DatasetReportRenderer` write the same flag onto bare `chart` nodes. `ChartRenderer` renders those directly (plugin-charts' `index.tsx` gives it the bare `chart` key and registers `ObjectChartBlock` as `view:chart` only), and its own `schema` prop declares the flag, so they do not go through `ObjectChartSchema`.
- **The member.** `isAnimationActive?: boolean` on the TypeScript `ObjectChartSchema` in `objectql.ts`, documented as host-composed. ⛔ No zod member.
- **Parity ledger.** `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` gets a new `RuntimeOnlyDeclared` entry, `objectql.zod.ts#ObjectChartSchema`, with its reason on `RuntimeOnlyNamedAllowList`. Unlike every other entry there, it is not a reclassification out of `UnmirroredDeclared`: the key was declared on neither face before this PR. The header figures move to 5 entries / 30 keys.
- **Fixtures.** The five fixtures in the three `ObjectChart` test files compile against the declaration as written. None needed an edit.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/plugins/plugin-charts.mdx` gets a section on the host-composed flag.

## Item 3: plugin-gantt TS2352 conversions

- **`ObjectGantt.tsx` (`warnOnShadowedFlatGanttKeys`).** `FLAT_GANTT_CONFIG_KEYS` holds the 29 `GanttConfigSchema` keys plus `dependencyField`, and `ObjectGanttSchema` declares all of them. So `schema[key]` is typed as it stands, and the `Record` conversion is gone.
- **`ObjectGantt.propertiesBag-10859.test.tsx`.** The render helper converts through `unknown`, with a comment saying why: the fixtures are unjudged document JSON, and two of them (`FLAT`, `FLAT_CONFIG`) are spellings the validator refuses. This follows the plugin-map precedent from PR #11384.

## Readings

### Proof the pins and the reads can fail (at `3383589ea`)

Every leg ran through `ablation-replace` (anchor x1 → x0, blob changed, then restored to equal HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty). The tree was clean after all five legs.

- **A.** `ActionBarSchema` regains `[key: string]: any`. The new pin `action-bar-chart-flag-11355.test.ts` goes red: TS2344 on `_ActionBarHasNoIndexSignature` and `_ActionBarMembers`, and TS2578 on the now-unused `@ts-expect-error` for the misspelt key.
- **B.** The `ObjectChartSchema` runtime-only entry is removed. `tsc` goes red naming the pair: `'"objectql.zod.ts#ObjectChartSchema"' is not assignable to type 'never'`, plus TS2344 on the allow-list pin. vitest gives `Tests 2 failed | 35 passed (37)` (both header-figure pins).
- **C (reverse verification across the package boundary).** In `InterfaceListPage`, `location` is misspelt `locaton`. This gives TS2561 against the rebuilt types `.d.ts` (`'locaton' does not exist in type 'ActionBarSchema'`), with the signature on `BaseSchema` still present.
- **D (reverse verification).** One plugin-charts fixture writes `isAnimationActive: 'no'`. This gives TS2322 `Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'boolean | undefined'` against the rebuilt `.d.ts`.
- **E.** Under P1, `ObjectGanttSchema` stops declaring `dependencyField`, and types is rebuilt (dist count of that member 0). This gives TS2551 at the typed shadowed-key read in `warnOnShadowedFlatGanttKeys`, and at `getGanttConfig`'s flat read. The read is checked; it is not `any`.

  - They also include every app-shell test importing `EnvironmentListToolbar`, `InterfaceListPage`, `ObjectView` or `useOfferedNavRunAction`, and the three `ObjectChart` fixture files.

## Merge with main

PR objectui#11425 (objectui#10859 batch 7) landed first, as `063832222`, and edits the same parity header. Merged, never rebased. The one conflict is the cross-ledger sentence, reconciled by census: 0 of the 5 shared, union 13 = 8 + 5. The figures prose beside it moves to the same digits.

## Acceptance notes

- **Not this card's: components' test program has 10 `error TS` under P1, at base and at head.** They are `props` x4, `visibility` x2, `properties` x2, `content`, and a `params` typing in `action-params-templates-7867`. components was not in this card's census population, so they are for objectui#8347's own re-derivation.
- **Typing plugin-detail's bars is outside this claim's surface.** `DetailView` and `RecordDetailPanel` build `action:bar` nodes through `as unknown as SchemaNode` or inside an untyped array. They could now be typed `ActionBarSchema`. Carrier: none.
- **An authored `isAnimationActive` is kept unjudged, as before this PR.** Measured with `safeValidateSchema`, the authored `object-chart` node keeps the key both written flat and inside `properties`, through passthrough. It is not declared there and not refused. Whether such a key reaches `ChartRenderer` from a stored document is NOT MEASURED.
